[[Al-Arabi (Saudi Arabian Sport Club)|Al-Arabi]] | continentalcup1 = | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | matches = | total goals = | average goals = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[1989–90 Saudi Premier League|1989-90]] | nextseason = [[1991–92 Saudi Premier League|1991-92]] }} In December 1990, the Saudi Federation decided to merge all the football League with the King's Cup in one tournament and the addition of the '''Golden Box'''. The Golden Box would be an end of season knockout competition played between the top four teams of the regular league season. These teams would play at a semi-final stage to crown the champions of Saudi Arabia. [[Al-Shabab (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Shabab]] came out on top and won their first championship. At the other end of the table, promoted sides [[Al-Najma SC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Najma]] and [[Al-Arabi (Saudi Arabian Sport Club)|Al-Arabi]] struggled and were relegated. ==Stadia and locations== {{Location map+ |Saudi Arabia |width=400 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 1990-91 Saudi Premier League |places= {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=21.54333 |long=39.17278 |label=[[Jeddah]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=24.68800|long=46.72243 |label=[[Riyadh]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=26.40000|long=50.15000 |label=[[Dammam]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=26.28333|long=50.20000 |label=[[Al Khubar]] }} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=21.41667|long=39.81667 |label=[[Mecca]] }} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=27.516667|long=41.683333 |label=[[Ha'il]] }} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=26.084|long=43.994 |label=[[Unaizah]]|position=left}} }} {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
